setupScript: set -u; ROOT="${CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$ROOT" ]; then echo "[conductor setup] ERROR: CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH ($ROOT) is unset or not a directory" >&2; exit 1; fi; copied_client=0; for f in .env .env.local; do if [ -f "$ROOT/client/$f" ]; then cp "$ROOT/client/$f" "client/$f" && copied_client=1; fi; done; if [ "$copied_client" = 0 ]; then echo "[conductor setup] WARN: no client/.env or client/.env.local found in root checkout ($ROOT/client) - skipping" >&2; fi; if [ -f "$ROOT/server/.env" ]; then cp "$ROOT/server/.env" server/.env; else echo "[conductor setup] WARN: no server/.env found in root checkout ($ROOT/server/.env) - skipping" >&2; fi; for d in . client server packages/shared-types packages/test-utils; do src="$ROOT/$d/node_modules"; dest="$d/node_modules"; if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then echo "[conductor setup] ERROR: missing $src - the root checkout has no installed dependencies. Run 'nvm use && yarn install' in $ROOT, then recreate this workspace." >&2; exit 1; fi; ln -sfn "$src" "$dest" || { echo "[conductor setup] ERROR: failed to symlink $dest -> $src" >&2; exit 1; }; done; echo "[conductor setup] OK: linked node_modules from $ROOT"
